rules.title: IFC schema version
rules.check: FILE_SCHEMA in header must be IFC4
rules.detail: IFC2X3 and IFC4X3 exports are rejected.
rules.fix: Re-export with schema IFC4.

rules.title: Model View Definition
rules.check: Header ViewDefinition must declare a Reference View
rules.detail: IFC+SG is based on the IFC4 Reference View MVD. Design Transfer View exports are not the accepted submission format.
rules.fix: Set MVD to IFC4 Reference View in the export dialog.

rules.title: File integrity
rules.check: File must parse without structural error
rules.fix: Re-export. Check for aborted export or truncated write.

rules.title: IfcMapConversion present
rules.check: IfcMapConversion must exist and reference an IfcProjectedCRS
rules.fix: Configure IfcMapConversion in the authoring tool before export.

rules.title: Correct projected CRS
rules.check: IfcProjectedCRS.Name should identify SVY21 / Singapore TM (EPSG:3414)
rules.fix: Set the project coordinate system to SVY21 and re-run the map conversion setup.

rules.title: Vertical datum
rules.check: Z values must be expressed relative to Singapore Height Datum
rules.fix: Correct the project base elevation so level 0 corresponds to the intended SHD value.

rules.title: Cross-discipline geo alignment
rules.check: Eastings, northings and elevation of the map conversion must match across ARC, STR and MEP models within tolerance
rules.detail: One of the most frequent Quality Check failures.
rules.fix: Agree one survey point set at project setup and propagate it to every discipline workset.

rules.title: Spatial hierarchy complete
rules.check: IfcProject, IfcSite, IfcBuilding and IfcBuildingStorey must all be present and correctly aggregated
rules.fix: Assign models to spatial containment before export.

rules.title: No orphan elements
rules.check: Every IfcElement must be contained in an IfcBuildingStorey or IfcSite via IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure
rules.fix: Reassign elements outside any storey range or on unassigned levels.

rules.title: Storey naming consistency
rules.check: IfcBuildingStorey.Name should follow a consistent, human-readable convention and be identical across disciplines
rules.fix: Align level names and elevations across the project before modelling proceeds.

rules.title: Block mechanism
rules.check: Where a development has multiple blocks, IfcBuilding instances must reflect the block breakdown consistently across disciplines
rules.fix: Apply the IFC+SG Block Mechanism per the General Modelling Practices guide.

rules.title: No regulated element as proxy
rules.check: Elements that map to an Identified Component must not export as IfcBuildingElementProxy
rules.fix: Correct the IFC class mapping or apply an IFC4 Override on the source element.

rules.title: Subtype declared
rules.check: Where the mapping requires a subtype, PredefinedType must be set, or PredefinedType=USERDEFINED with a non-empty ObjectType carrying the IFC+SG token
rules.fix: Set PredefinedType, or set USERDEFINED plus the ObjectType token from the mapping file.

rules.title: Subtype token valid
rules.check: ObjectType token must exist in the loaded IFC+SG mapping for that entity
rules.fix: Replace with a token from the mapping file. Do not invent tokens.

rules.title: Required SGPset present
rules.check: Every element matching an Identified Component must carry the SGPsets required by the mapping for its entity and subtype
rules.fix: Assign the userdefined Pset to the element or its type and re-export.

rules.title: Property in the correct property set
rules.check: Each property must sit in the Pset or SGPset the mapping assigns it to
rules.detail: FireRating belongs to Pset_WallCommon, not SGPset_Wall.
rules.fix: Move the property to the correct set in the export mapping configuration.

rules.title: Property name exact match
rules.check: Property names are case-sensitive and must match the mapping exactly, with no leading or trailing whitespace
rules.detail: Manually created parameters are the dominant source of spelling errors.
rules.fix: Drive parameters from the supplied configuration files rather than typing them.

rules.title: Data type match
rules.check: Property value type must match the declared IFC+SG data type
rules.detail: A Boolean written as the text 'Yes' fails. A Length written as a Label fails.
rules.fix: Correct the parameter type in the authoring tool, not just the value.

rules.title: Non-empty required value
rules.check: Required properties must carry a value; null, empty string and placeholder text fail
rules.detail: Instance parameters default to empty on newly created elements.
rules.fix: Populate values, or set at type level so every instance inherits.

rules.title: Enumeration value valid
rules.check: Where the mapping defines controlled values, the value must be one of them, matched exactly
rules.detail: Spaces submitted for URA approval must strictly use the published controlled values.
rules.fix: Replace with a value from the mapping. Use an 'Others' value plus a note property only where the mapping provides one.

rules.title: Redundant dimension declaration
rules.check: IFC+SG dimension properties that already match the native object parameter need not be declared in the project
rules.fix: Remove the manual duplicate and let the vendor configuration export it automatically. Duplicates risk divergent values.

rules.title: Vendor noise property sets
rules.check: Native vendor property sets bloat the file and add no regulatory value
rules.fix: Exclude from the IFC export configuration.

rules.title: GUID stability
rules.check: IfcGloballyUniqueId should remain stable across successive exports of the same element
rules.detail: Stable GUIDs make successive submissions diffable and let agencies track amendments.
rules.fix: Do not recreate elements unnecessarily; use an export configuration that preserves GUIDs.

rules.title: Source traceability
rules.check: Element Tag, source file and model name should be exported so an IFC failure can be traced back to the authoring element
rules.fix: Enable element ID tracking in the export configuration.

rules.title: Unit assignment declared and consistent
rules.check: IfcUnitAssignment must declare length, area and volume units consistently across discipline models
rules.fix: Standardise project units at setup.

rules.title: File size and geometry weight
rules.check: Excessive tessellation and imported detail inflate file size and slow agency review
rules.fix: Reduce unnecessary geometric detail; exclude non-regulated high-polygon content where not required.

rules.title: Duplicate elements
rules.check: Coincident duplicate elements distort counts and area accounting
rules.fix: Purge duplicates before export.

rules.title: Mapping edition stamped
rules.check: The audit report must record which industry mapping edition and COP edition it was run against
rules.fix: Stamp every generated report with the mapping file date.
